author: Kobcy
body:
Yes. I'm so disappointed by the administrator "Posighdun". He closed my appeal without ONE comment and didn't provide evidence. Isn't this against your staff policies? I did request evidence and I did it nicely, locking my appeal without one simple comment is outrageous. I think he did it because he didn't have evidence at all and he didn't want to unban me. Now if you will lock this thread and archive it again, I will personally contact the owner and tell him about the corruptness which is going on here. I'll also make a public thread about it in the category "Server Feedback". If you're going to web-ban this account for Ban Evasion, I already request the evidence now. I'd like you to send it to my email: kobcymc@gmail.com

Here is the evidence of the closed appeal:

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello,
after checking your ip and looking further into it I came to the conclussion that you aren't using a vpn and that therefore you are not ban evading. I do sincerly apologise for banning you as we have recently been targetted by a group of people who have been using vpns and ban evading. You joined the server, for the first time, just as they were doing their daily attacks so I pressumed that you were one of them. After looking into it a bit it is clear you aren't so I do apologise for that. I locked the appeal because at the exact same time, which I thought was too good of a coincidence, some ban evaders were requesting evidence for the exact same thing so I pressumed you were with them so I just locked it without commenting on it. Once again I do apologise and it is my fault, there was no corruptness just a bit of a miss understanding.You are appealed.
